privacyPolicy.introduction: Welcome to Sotwe. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. If you have any questions or concerns about our policy or our practices with regards to your personal information, please contact us at {app_email}.

content.informationWeCollect: As a visitor, you can browse our site to find out more about our website. You are not required to provide us with any personal information as a visitor. We collect your personal information when you register with us or when you use our services. The personal information we collect might include your name, email address, and profile picture.

useList.provideAndMaintain: Provide, operate, and maintain our website

useList.understandAndAnalyze: Understand and analyze how you use our website
useList.developNew: Develop new products, services, features, and functionality
useList.communicate: Communicate with you, including for customer service and marketing purposes

content.dataProtection: Sotwe follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected by log files include IP addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. This information is not linked to any information that is personally identifiable.
content.policyChanges: We may update this Privacy, and have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to secure your information. We regularly review and update our security measures to ensure that your information remains protected. However, no method of transmitting or storing data is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the security of your information. By using our website, you acknowledge that you understand and accept the risks associated with sharing your information online.
